# Braindecode

> PyTorch-based deep learning for EEG, ECoG and MEG.

Braindecode package version: 1.8.1

Documentation scope: https://braindecode.org/dev/

Source commit: [b9760cc2cfd3c4fe3301897c3b27e4266764a8c8](https://github.com/braindecode/braindecode/tree/b9760cc2cfd3c4fe3301897c3b27e4266764a8c8)

This index describes only this documentation build. The dev path is a moving development snapshot, even when the package version has no dev suffix. Match your installed version before using API examples; do not infer stable release behavior from dev documentation.

Selected Markdown pages are rendered from canonical Sphinx documentation. HTML remains authoritative for interactive tables, figures and custom directives. Examples may download data or weights and run training; reading these pages does not execute them.
